title: Crown of Glass / 名ばかりの女王

metadata.tags:
**Genre/Style:** Minimal baroque chamber opera × reflective gothic lullaby × ceremonial ambient. 92 BPM slow 4/4. Sparse harpsichord motifs, soft legato strings, warm organ drones, distant choir pads. No percussion. Occasional crystal chime accents. Waterfall ambience faint but present.

**Vocal Direction:** Soprano restrained, intimate, almost spoken in places. No coloratura attack. Long held notes that thin into breath. Choir enters only in final chorus, supportive but distant.

**Mood:** Dignified relinquishment. Bittersweet clarity. Power without authority. Ceremony without control.

**Structure:** Quiet Overture → Verse 1 (Recognition) → Pre-Chorus (Letting Go) → Chorus (Title Without Power) → Verse 2 (Identity Shift) → Bridge (Silence and Acceptance) → Final Chorus (Ceremonial Resolve) → Breath Coda.
metadata.prompt:
## OVERTURE — Empty Throne

*(soft organ; single chime)*

The hall is full.
The throne is light.

The scepter rests
but does not bite.

霧は遠い。

## VERSE I — Recognition

I wore the sky like armor bright.
I called that hunger sacred right.

But crowns are loud
when held too tight.

And I mistook
the roar for sight.

## PRE-CHORUS — Unfastening

*(harpsichord slows; strings soften)*

What is a queen
without decree?

What is command
without belief?

## CHORUS — Crown of Glass

*(strings swell gently)*

I am a crown of glass and light.

Seen from afar—
Clear in the night.

名ばかりの女王
静かに立つ。

No hand on law.
No blade to press.

Only a symbol
in formal dress.

## VERSE II — Identity Shift

They bow—
but not from fear.

They speak—
and I must hear.

The power left.
The title stayed.

An echo of the role I played.

Is this less?

Or is it more?

To guard the frame
instead of war.

## BRIDGE — Reflection

*(music nearly silent; faint choir hum)*

I thought the height
was where I stood.

But height is hollow
without the good.

If I am myth,
let myth be kind.

If I am symbol,
let me remind.

## FINAL CHORUS — Ceremony

*(choir enters softly; organ warm)*

I am a crown of glass and light.

Ceremonial,
not the fight.

名ばかりの女王
息を守る。

If I cannot command the flame,
I will protect
what bears my name.

Not ruler.

Witness crowned.

Not sovereign—

But bound.

## CODA — Breath in the Hall

*(music thins; single sustained note fades)*

The throne remains.

The world moves on.

I stand.

息。
